opening.argument: The presentation ties paid packages to token and coin allocations while building compensation through referrals and network activity. It offers packages from EUR 100 to EUR 5,000 and says, “if you refer somebody you're gonna get a commission You're also going to get paid from a network bonus.” The package slide links those prices with OneAcademy levels, #ONETOKEN quantities, and #AGC-COINS quantities. Its account-value pitch says accounts can double every 40 to 60 days, while the three-year chart displays base and optimistic OneCoin scenarios reaching EUR 50.00 or EUR 100.00, though it labels those figures as predictions. The presentation also describes compensation extending four generations with unlimited width and claims substantial participant earnings, while acknowledging income is not guaranteed. Against those qualifications, the repeated invitation to get involved, position for success, and partner with the team today uses financial projections and earnings claims to solicit recruitment.
